repositoryBodies.label: repo-20260729
repositoryBodies.defect: MISSING `return;` after the RESPONDED-branch `return query`: plpgsql continues executing, so an idempotent retry AND a conflicting second outcome both fall through to the UPDATE + audit INSERT. The caller reads data[0] and sees 'unchanged'/'already_responded' while the row was actually overwritten and a spurious audit row written. Violates first-response-wins, retry idempotency, and append-only audit fidelity.
